name: 12 small square seats
license: Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial (supplied notice; version unspecified)
step_kind: Faceted generated Pegstr body; separate analytic receiver STEP
generator: Original Pegstr OpenSCAD modules, recovered profile settings, custom flush receiving back
changes: Generated directly with Pegstr, changing the column count while retaining the opening profile, pitch, four depth rows, scalloped front and gusseted form. Native source output has a slightly different gusset and outer rounding from the older archived STL; P09 is 0.33 mm shallower. Continuous custom receiving back grows with the array.

print_review.orientation: Right side down; mirror in slicer for a left-handed placement
print_review.reason: Retain the original through-seat profiles and keep peg centerlines in the layer plane. No extra cheek or change to the pocket shape.
print_review.review: Local plate-grown supports remain necessary under the pegs. Square roofs bridge about 6.5 mm; round roofs retain the original curved overhang. P01-12 also needs a local support under the narrower pocket bank, 4.44 mm above the back-wall edge. No slicer or print qualification.

qualification: CAD form variant. Not sliced, printed or physically fit-tested.

current_peg_fit.lower_locator: Exact baseline lower locator, unchanged; designed for 3.94 mm board
current_peg_fit.construction: Canonical cylinder/sphere upper core and exact 120-degree cylindrical lower bearing segment. User-authorized parameter revision.
current_peg_fit.scope: Intentional interference: negative clearance requires plastic/board compliance. Assumed board grip, not measured thickness. No force or recoverable deformation claim.

fit_revision_note: Mounted CAD updated globally. Earlier fit, motion and slice evidence in this document is historical; current geometric verification is peg-fit.json.
